test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 3)

question: In a certain code language, 'GLAND’ is written as 'GQDOJ' and 'MEANS' is written as 'VQDHP'. How will 'CYSTS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (3) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

​So,

 
• 'GLAND’ is written as 'GQDOJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d95f739e20a12a6b1923ae26e942319c7bf9c7726d461d5d146cae59716865d1.png] ​

And,

 
• 'MEANS' is written as 'VQDHP'

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/951f275b62b49f38e7691db726a7f83a490e5aadf9cb25a8ee1e74d03c2b6d3d.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'CYSTS' is written as 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/562f0ef0937378560eb377200914fdec986ffda58b876d155ebdc5ae68175885.png] 

Hence, "**VWVBF**" is the correct answer.
